title: Meeting agenda
description: When a meeting without an agenda is read for one somebody stated.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes, to meetings that reach the threshold after that.

autoDeriveAfterSeconds.title: Seconds into a meeting to look for a stated agenda
autoDeriveAfterSeconds.description: Seconds into a meeting with no agenda before its transcript is read once for one; 0 turns this off.
